## Task

Create the first focused PR for issue #277: make /install a first-class route for authorization while still executing the bundled install-agent skill. Build on PR #273's /install parser and INSTALL_TARGET_REPO plumbing. Requirements: return/evaluate route key install rather than skill for /install owner/repo; keep effective skill execution as install-agent; ensure AGENT_ACCESS_POLICY.route_overrides.install can allow/deny independently from skill; add focused tests for valid/invalid /install and route_overrides.install policy behavior; update access-policy/install docs with the recommended install route override example. Do not implement AGENT_INSTALL_PAT, fork creation, or cross-repo PR mechanics in this PR; leave those for the next child PR. Preserve the onboarding/setup-todo PR body ideas from discussion #271 and PR #273 docs, but only adjust them if route/policy wording changes require it.
